dispositions.finding: Contradictory verifier success/protected-routing failure could pass summary checks
dispositions.resolution: Reproduce final verdict, reasons and counts from every raw probe; require complete window and declared environment outcome. The injected routing failure remains recorded and is allowed only as an unhealthy environment outcome where the protocol permits it. Documentation makes non-routing protected invariants explicit.

dispositions.finding: Version omits evaluated image and repeated promotion can obscure activation evidence
dispositions.resolution: Version includes release and image identities. Store immutable definition separately from complete per-decision receipts; pin the activating revision, preserving it through rejected candidates and later promotions.

dispositions.finding: A complete behavioral/environment miss raises rather than retaining a rejected candidate receipt
dispositions.resolution: Require fixed environment outcome only for no-action controls. Candidate outcomes retain actual recovery and environment_matches; misses or unknowns cannot authorize admission and do not erase other candidates.

dispositions.finding: Refused evidence and stale administrative attempts lack durable ledger records
dispositions.resolution: Record evidence/stale promotion and withdrawal refusals in a separate SQLite table without advancing admission revision. Gate retains stage, safe refusal reason and incremental receipts.

reviews.coverage_note: Final packet contains module, checker and protocol. Unit-test file hash is recorded; test body omitted after an over-budget preflight. No model generation occurred for the rejected full packet.

dispositions.finding: New-pin refusals lack a durable ledger record
dispositions.resolution: Pin refusals use the same separate refusal log. Storage-unavailable errors cannot promise durable records; this qualification is explicit. Both promotion and withdrawal still fail without changing authority if SQLite cannot write.

dispositions.finding: executescript implicitly commits before schema initialization
dispositions.resolution: Execute schema statements individually within BEGIN IMMEDIATE. Actual SQLite authorization failure during table creation now rolls all tables back; a retry initializes fully. Concurrent initialization test also passes.

followup: All six findings investigated and addressed or clarified. Final pin-refusal and schema-transaction corrections have focused tests; the last Fable snapshot precedes those two corrections. No admission bypass found in the last model review. Live results remain separate.
